About.headline: One Holding. Five Businesses. One Platform.
About.subline: DESHold is a Dordrecht-based business group that builds and operates companies at the intersection of physical trade and technology. We don’t just invest — we build, run, and grow.
About.story_p1: DESHold grew from a single idea: that operational businesses become more defensible when technology is built into them from the start — not bolted on later.
About.story_p2: Founded by Sunay Duman, DESHold began as a vehicle trading operation and evolved into a multi-entity group spanning mobility, IT consultancy, e-commerce, and property. Every business in the group shares the same proprietary platform: DES BOP — built in-house to connect leads, listings, invoicing, analytics, and AI automation in one system.
About.story_p3: We are headquartered in Dordrecht, Netherlands, and operate across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, France, and Turkey.
About.cta_sub: We’re always open to new opportunities and conversations.

Careers.headline: Build Real Businesses. Use Real Technology.
Careers.subline: DESHold is not a big corporation. We’re a small, fast group of people running real businesses across Europe — and we use technology we built ourselves to do it. If that sounds interesting, we want to hear from you.
Careers.culture_eyebrow: What It’s Like to Work Here
Careers.culture_p1: We’re based in Dordrecht, operating across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, and beyond. Our team is small on purpose: we prefer people who take ownership over people who wait for instructions.
Careers.culture_p2: You’ll work with custom software (DES BOP), real physical operations (vehicle trading, e-commerce), and European markets where the details matter. We don’t have a lot of layers. Work here makes a direct visible difference.
Careers.open_body: We regularly grow into new areas. If you’re a builder, operator, or problem-solver who shares our mindset, send us a message. We review all open applications.

BusinessesPage.hero_subline: Each DESHold company operates independently but shares the same infrastructure, platform, and ambition: to lead its market through technology.
BusinessesPage.platform_heading: All Businesses Run on DES Platform
BusinessesPage.platform_body: Every company in our group shares one platform — DES BOP — for leads, invoicing, listings, analytics, and AI automation. This is our competitive moat: built in-house, owned outright, and improving every week.

PlatformPage.headline: The Technology Behind Every Business.
PlatformPage.subline: DES BOP (Business Operating Platform) is our proprietary system — built in-house on Next.js, Supabase, and AI — connecting all operations across the DESHold group in one intelligent ecosystem.
PlatformPage.what_p1: DES Platform is not a third-party SaaS tool. It is a custom-built operating layer that runs every DESHold business — from the first customer lead to the final invoice.
PlatformPage.what_p2: Built by DES Tech and continuously developed by our team, DES BOP replaces a patchwork of separate tools with one unified system. Every business unit has its own workspace; all data flows to a shared analytics layer.
PlatformPage.why_quote: Off-the-shelf tools are someone else’s competitive advantage. We built our own.
PlatformPage.why_1_body: No per-seat SaaS fees that scale with headcount.
PlatformPage.why_2_body: We own the data, the logic, and the roadmap.
PlatformPage.why_3_body: Our speed of operation is not replicable by competitors using generic tools.
PlatformPage.partner_heading: Interested in DES Platform for Your Business?
PlatformPage.partner_body: DES Tech builds and implements custom business platforms for external clients. If you’re a dealer, trader, or SME looking for a similar system, we’d like to talk.
